method: breaths by loudness (under -18 dB for 0.3 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 17 of 24 breaks heard

lines.english: Loving
Mother of the Redeemer,
who remainest the open gate of heaven,
and star of the sea,
succour the falling
people who strive to rise again:
thou who, while nature marvelled, didst bring forth
thy holy Creator,
Virgin before
and after,

lines.latin: Gabriélis ab ore sumens illud Ave, peccatórum miserére.
lines.english: who from the mouth of Gabriel didst receive that Ave, have mercy on sinners.
The Angel of the Lord declared unto Mary.
And she conceived of the Holy Ghost.
Let us pray.

lines.latin: Grátiam tuam quǽsumus, Dómine, méntibus nostris infúnde:
lines.english: Pour forth, we beseech Thee, O Lord, Thy grace into our hearts;

lines.latin: ut qui, ángelo nuntiánte, Christi Fílii tui incarnatiónem cognóvimus;
lines.english: that we, to whom the Incarnation of Christ, Thy Son, was made known by the message of an Angel,

lines.latin: per passiónem ejus et crucem, ad resurrectiónis glóriam perducámur.
lines.english: may by His Passion and Cross be brought to the glory of His Resurrection.
Through the same Christ our Lord.
Amen.
After childbirth, O Virgin, thou didst remain inviolate.
O Mother of God, intercede for us.
Let us pray.

lines.latin: Deus, qui salútis ætérnæ, beátæ Maríæ virginitáte fecúnda, humáno géneri prǽmia præstitísti:
lines.english: O God, who by the fruitful virginity of Blessed Mary hast bestowed upon mankind the rewards of eternal salvation;

lines.latin: tríbue, quǽsumus; ut ipsam pro nobis intercédere sentiámus, per quam merúimus auctórem vitæ suscípere, Dóminum nostrum Jesum Christum Fílium tuum.
lines.english: grant, we beseech Thee, that we may know the help of her intercession, through whom we were made worthy to receive the Author of life, our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son.
Amen.
